correctness.rationale: Conditioning on one vertex gives an exact Gaussian mixture. A two-cofactor conditioning step identifies every off-diagonal cofactor-square product with one third of the preceding fourth moment, giving the exact recurrence \(M_n=(2n-1)(2n+1)M_{n-1}\) from base \(M_1=3\). The second moment and sign symmetry are proved by the same edge decomposition. No experiment or asymptotic limit is needed.

value.rationale: The fourth standardized moment is a natural invariant for the same Gaussian-hafnian anticoncentration problem. The exact value \(2n+1\) gives a sharp all-order measure of increasingly heavy normalized fourth tails and exposes an exact moment-level coincidence with the Pfaffian benchmark beyond the two orders where equality in law is known. The statement is structural and dimension-uniform rather than an arbitrary finite computation.
